Shows file facts and pixel statistics only — this tool does not parse EXIF camera metadata. Everything is processed locally in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image onto the dropzone or click to browse.
  2. Wait a moment while the pixels are analyzed.
  3. Read the file facts, dimensions and average color.
  4. Study the 16-bin luminance histogram for the brightness spread.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does this show EXIF camera data?

No. It reads file facts (name, size, type, dimensions) and computes pixel statistics (average color, luminance histogram) — it does not parse EXIF, IPTC or XMP metadata.

How is the average color calculated?

The average is computed from every pixel of a downscaled copy of your image, so it genuinely represents the whole picture.

Is my image uploaded anywhere?

Yes — everything is processed locally in your browser. The file never leaves your device.
